question: The average weight of L, M and N is 93 kg. If the average weight of L and M be 89 kg and that of M and N be 96.5 kg, then the weight (in kg) of M is ______
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Weight of common person (M) = [Sum of individual pairs] − [Total sum]

M = 2 × (AvgL₊M + AvgM₊N) − 3 × (AvgL₊M₊N)

M = 2 × (89 + 96.5) − 3 × 93

M = 2 × 185.5 − 279 = 371 − 279 = 92 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 92 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of (L, M, N) = 93 kg

Average weight of (L, M) = 89 kg

Average weight of (M, N) = 96.5 kg

**Formula Used:**

Total Weight = Average Weight × Number of persons

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49a6c05000e26f43a2da578bcc4cd7d307ffd2a32d3fa3fe29d2e2764c4b6b8f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total weight of (L + M + N) = 93 × 3 = 279 kg --- (Eq. 1)

⇒ Total weight of (L + M) = 89 × 2 = 178 kg --- (Eq. 2)

⇒ Total weight of (M + N) = 96.5 × 2 = 193 kg --- (Eq. 3)

⇒ Weight of M = (Total weight of L + M) + (Total weight of M + N) − (Total weight of L + M + N)

⇒ Weight of M = 178 + 193 − 279

⇒ Weight of M = 371 − 279

⇒ Weight of M = 92 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 92 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Concept

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Deviation Method

If the average of n terms is A, and one term is part of two overlapping subsets, the term = A + ∑(Deviations). This avoids large multiplications.

Weighted Average

Combined Average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the number of items and x is the average of each group.</p
